newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports details div payout, sets AGM date.
newsitem.headline: Ports details div payout, sets AGM date.

text.p: Ports of Auckland on Monday said it would now hold its Annual General Meeting on November 11, rather than in October, delaying by about one month the payment of its final dividend.
The final dividend payment would be made on November 15.
Directors were recommending a final dividend of 10 cents per share, bringing the total dividend for the 1995-96 year to 18 cents per share.
The recommendation would be put for shareholder approval at the AGM, which would be held in the Downtown Convention Centre, Auckland.
The Share Register will close for the payment of the final dividend at 5 p.m. on November 1.
The company had indicated to the Stock Exchange that the likely date for the AGM would be October, but it would now be November to allow more time for a new constitution to be finalised.
